description: Put a tag on a job. Tags are how jobs get grouped for reporting and follow-up. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. This tool sends nothing to the customer itself; what your own Housecall Pro automations do with a tagged job is set up in Housecall Pro and outside this server's control. Housecall Pro identifies tags by id, so a tag name is looked up for you first and rejected with suggestions if it does not match one exactly.

tag_id.description: Tag id (tag_...) from hcp_list_tags. A tag name is accepted only if it matches one exactly.

name: hcp_add_job_tag
